_comment_regions: Run the functions next to the data.
Vercel defaults every new project to iad1, Washington D.C. Supabase and
Upstash for this project are both in ap-southeast-1, Singapore, so every
database query and every rate-limit check was crossing the Pacific twice:
measured at 235ms warm and 1644ms cold for a SELECT 1 that the database
sin1 is Singapore. A Hobby plan may pick one region, which is all this
needs. Setting it here rather than in the dashboard keeps it in version
control, so a re-imported project does not silently revert to Washington.
If the database ever moves, this must move with it.
